top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks for Katori and Ye rest on a specific, checkable idea (magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms) and have been reproduced and cross-compared at the 1e-18 level by independent laboratories. The two-name attribution is clean, the citation scope is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes, and the work opens access to new physics. This is mature and verified, so it is preferable to no award.
